board: MQ-137 ammonia gas sensor module, common blue board with LM393 comparator (4-pin header: VCC, GND, DO, AO)
reason: The first check run passed on ESP32 and Pico: wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator (AO voltage slider and active-low DO toggle) and circuit board. AO is modelled as the datasheet's VRL across the load resistor. The driver uses Rs = (Vc/VRL - 1) x RL with R0 measured in clean air, as the Winsen datasheet defines it. Supply is 4.9-5.1 V, about 180 mA (heater 29 ohm at 5.0 V).
